arguments.text: Findings: The ticket reports the nightly payroll export timing out after 30 minutes and leaving a truncated file. The last batch record, E-102, has a salary of £91,000, which can be used to verify whether the final record was exported correctly. No logs or export artifact are attached here, so I could not confirm the exact failure point or whether E-102 was cut off.
